items.label: Advertise
items.title: 📢 Promote Your Website, Product or Channel
items.text:
Reach FreeTV Garden visitors with your **website, product, business, app, YouTube channel or social media page.**

**24-hour advertising plans**

• Standard listing: ₹29 weekdays / ₹49 weekends
• Featured listing: ₹59 weekdays / ₹79 weekends
• Top pinned placement: ₹79 weekdays / ₹99 weekends

**Placement options**

• Standard: regular position in the Sponsored panel
• Featured: higher priority in the panel
• Top pinned: priority placement at the top

Prices are introductory. Weekend rates apply Friday–Sunday. All plans run for 24 hours from the agreed start time. Placement is subject to approval and availability.
